cardOverview.overviewText: The RBL Bank World Plus Credit Card is a lifestyle-focused card that earns reward points on everyday spending and sweetens your year with perks like complimentary domestic airport lounge access, dining and international spend rewards, movie offers, fuel surcharge waivers and a global acceptance network.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Get 1+1 free movie ticket (Up to INR 200), on BookMyShow, twice a month on any day of the week.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Dedicated Concierge Help Desk will assist you with all your bookings.
